Package gov.cdc.izgateway.model

Interface DynamoDbEntity

All Superinterfaces:
DbAudit
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractDestination, AbstractEndpointStatus, DynamoDbAudit, NoopEndpointStatusRepository.EndpointStatus
public interface DynamoDbEntity extends DbAudit
This class is used to mark DynamoDbBean entities which use a single table design for storing data. Each entity must implement the primaryId() method, and may override the sortKey method. It assumes that all entities are uniquely identified by their simple class name.

    • getEntityType

      default String getEntityType()
      Compute the partition key for this object. The partition key is the simple type name of the object + the entity specific sort key.
      Returns:
      The partition key for this object.

    • getSortKey

      The sort key for this object.

    • setEntityType

      default void setEntityType(String value)
      Phantom setter for entityType The AWS DynamoDb SDK ignores bean properties that don't have both a reader and a writer, failing to understand that some properties could be derived and therefore NOT writable. Thus, this is ignored. This method exists simply to make DynamoDb work as expected for persistence.
